result.title: Seeing Beyond Pixels: Radar Feature Generation from Images and Sparse Returns
result.summary: Camera-radar fusion benefits from complementary visual and geometric information but often relies on complete radar representations, leading to substantial computing overhead. However, the extent to which visual information can compensate for limited radar measurements remains insufficiently explored. Therefore, we propose Vision-informed Radar Token Generation (VRTG), which exploits cross-modal information to generate task-relevant radar features from camera images and sparse radar measurements. Specifically, VRTG first leverages image-derived object cues to select a limited number of informative radar points. It then establishes calibrated one-to-one associations between visual objects and radar returns, using matched measurements to refine object ranges while retaining visual estimates for unmatched objects. Finally, the associated object features and visual context are transformed into radar tokens compatible with existing camera-radar fusion networks. Experiments on RADIal demonstrate that VRTG achieves 90.76\% vehicle-detection F1 and 86.68\% free-space mIoU using only four radar points per frame, approaching the performance of the full-radar model.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 VRTG：先用图像中的目标线索从雷达点云中挑选少量信息量高的测量，建立视觉目标与雷达回波的标定式一对一关联以精化距离，再把关联特征与视觉上下文转换为可与现有相机-雷达融合网络对接的 radar token；在 RADIal 上每帧仅用四个雷达点即接近全雷达模型性能。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「视觉线索筛稀疏证据、再跨模态生成缺失特征」的做法，可供核查 LVR 中真实观测证据与生成代理之间的区分、视觉旁路何时替代传感器证据，以及证据筛选与贡献分配的评测方式；但论文目标是检测指标，未涉及 latent 推理状态，迁移属推测。
